clues.text: This classic thrill machine climbs to a height of 70 feet, hits speeds of up to 50 mph, and features zero inversions.
Designed by the legendary John C. Allen, it was built by Philadelphia Toboggan Coasters and made its debut in 1967.
You can find this ride in the state of Georgia, located just south of the Tennessee border in Rossville.
